data.body: fix-bug:investigation: INVESTIGATION_COMPLETE. Root cause verified: migrate-closure-checks.sh has no epic-count cap or wall-time guard. The 25-item CLASSIFIER_BUDGET only caps ACK items (not epics), so with r=4 auto-approve active, the budget never exhausts and all N epics run in one Bash process to SIGKILL. closure-checks-classifier-pass.sh also has no wall-time guard. Fix: add --max-epics cap (default 20, env DSO_CLASSIFY_MAX_EPICS) and SECONDS-based wall-time guard (default 3600s, env DSO_CLASSIFY_WALL_TIME_SECS) to migrate-closure-checks.sh only. COMPLEXITY: TRIVIAL | FIXABLE: Yes | MANUAL_APPROVAL_NEEDED: No | COMPLEX_ESCALATION: No | SCRATCH_KEY: fix-bug:investigation
